answer: Deposits are visible in summit, and wander reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 36% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Because the custody account is separate, an adversary cannot recycle one pool of capital across 89 aliases, and each one needs its own funded oasis account. That bill is paid per identity, so 91 aliases cost 138 times the single-account price. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
